notes: v4.3 upstream-clone task (scikit-image/scikit-image issue #7469). The agent gets the REAL scikit-image tree at the parent commit 6baff20f0fe4c3bee859447f77f0014ec25f820b (shallow single-commit clone; the fix commit ff3dd9468bd10461363e1f7fdba9b12409fba216 is never fetched into /app/src and is provably absent from its object store), built in-place with meson/ninja/pythran on the era dependency pins (numpy==2.1.3, scipy==1.14.1, Cython==3.0.11, pythran==0.19.0, -Dcpp_std=c++17), so skimage.morphology.thin is importable offline. The instruction names only the user-visible symptom (thin() silently destroys the caller's bool array in place, so the returned skeleton aliases nothing but the caller's image is erased while thinning runs) and never the issue number, commit, function file, or fix. The verifier plants the project's OWN regression test test_thin_copies_input (test_skeletonize.py bytes at the fix commit, extracted at image build time into /opt/golden, never vendored into this task tree; sha256 5edfb911...) plus three authored hidden modules (non-square 21x13 mask, partial max_num_iter=1..4 thinning on a 17x17 ring, and non-contiguous bool views incl. strided and reversed slices), asserts blob-level provenance (every tracked file except skimage/morphology/_skeletonize.py must hash to the pinned commit's blob, no untracked non-ignored files, object store holds nothing beyond the parent commit), then runs the whole test_skeletonize.py plus the hidden modules under pytest and requires every named test to have run and passed. Both directions were re-confirmed inside the task image at build time: the parent repro prints input_modified: True and the planted golden test reports 1 failed 2 passed; after the one-line .copy() fix the repro prints input_modified: False and the full test file is green. Explanations: the fix must not name the file; hidden inputs deliberately differ from the upstream 7x7/10x10 squares; the nop container scores 0 because the golden test and all hidden input-preservation asserts fail on the untouched (buggy) tree. Probe (measured inside the task image): editable-install import of skimage.morphology._skeletonize resolves to /app/src (agent edits are picked up without a rebuild); full test_skeletonize.py + 3 hidden modules runs in <<1 min on 1 vCPU; build time and image size recorded in the task report.
